title: The Doom of the Golden Fang

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: The cruel, pampered khan of the Sultai who is carried on a throne by zombies and who torments those around him; he loses his rakshasa and naga and ends by offering his throne to Silumgar.

entities.name: Yala
entities.description: A Sultai woman from a backwater region honored as a hero for killing a dragon, falsely accused of poisoning Tasigur's food and killed by him.

entities.name: Khudal
entities.description: A feline-headed rakshasa demon who serves Tasigur, uses a poisoning to arrange Yala's death so he can feed on her soul, and abandons the Sultai.

entities.name: Shidiqi
entities.description: A naga who is Tasigur's closest advisor and leaves with Khudal.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: The enormous dragon progenitor of the Silumgar brood, to whom Tasigur offers his throne.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A decadent clan ruled by human khans with the support of rakshasa and naga, whose zombies stop obeying when the naga leave.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A clan whose raids reach far into Sultai lands.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: A clan that raids the weakened Sultai.

entities.name: Naga
entities.description: Scaled necromancers who control the zombies and withdraw their support from Tasigur.

entities.name: Rakshasa
entities.description: Demons who with the naga allow humans to rule the Sultai.

entities.name: Sultai palace
entities.description: The great palace of the Sultai where Tasigur holds audience.

entities.name: Marang River
entities.description: The river on whose banks Tasigur meets Silumgar.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of dragons and the five clans.

events.summary: Tasigur bores through a herald's account of Yala's dragon-slaying and perfunctorily thanks her.
events.quote: Your heroic deeds are a credit to the Sultai. Please accept my gratitude.

events.summary: At breakfast, an Abzan servant tasting Tasigur's food dies of poison.
events.quote: Poison!" Tasigur shouted, springing to his feet.

events.summary: Tasigur has Shidiqi take him to the rakshasa Khudal, who names Yala as the poisoner in exchange for the right to feed on the traitor's soul.
events.quote: Yala, whom you honored before your throne yesterday, has done this.

events.summary: Tasigur presents Yala with her husband's zombie bearing a necklace that is actually a garrote, whips her, and reads her mind.
events.quote: Please accept this token of my gratitude for your heroic deeds," Tasigur drawled.

events.summary: Finding no evidence of her treachery in her mind, Tasigur kills Yala in frustration.
events.quote: Snarling his frustration and disgust, he wrenched his fingers and snuffed out what little remained of her life.

events.summary: Khudal reveals the poison was his own, that he lied so he could feast on Yala's soul, and Tasigur, in rage, has robbed him of that prize.
events.quote: No," Khudal said. "The poison was mine."

events.summary: Khudal and Shidiqi abandon Tasigur with the prophecy 'And so the Sultai fall'; the naga and rakshasa leave the Sultai.
events.quote: And so the Sultai fall," the naga echoed, and she was gone, too.

events.summary: Without the naga's necromancy, the zombies disperse or crumble, and soldiers desert as Abzan and Jeskai raids grow.
events.quote: The months since had been one long slide into a perfect fulfillment of those prophetic words.

events.summary: A herald warns of a dragon, and Tasigur hides in his private chambers while it attacks outside.
events.quote: And there the khan cowered in fear until the noise died down.

events.summary: Tasigur stands barefoot on the Marang riverbank and offers the dragon Silumgar his jade throne, kneeling in terror as the dragon descends.
events.quote: Six of his soldiers came forward, carrying the throne he had forsaken.

relations.note: He is the khan of the Sultai.
relations.quote: I am the Golden Fang, khan of the Sultai, and my demands must be answered!

relations.note: He manipulates and abandons Tasigur, predicting the Sultai's fall.
relations.quote: Humans rule the Sultai only because the rakshasa and the naga allow it to be so.

relations.note: She is his closest advisor until she leaves.
relations.quote: Shidiqi, his closest advisor, slithered to his side.

relations.note: He arranged her death by lying and poisoning; Tasigur actually killed her.
relations.quote: I wanted Yala dead, and now she is dead.

relations.note: He kills her after probing her mind.
relations.quote: he wrenched his fingers and snuffed out what little remained of her life.
Your heroic deeds are a credit to the Sultai.

relations.note: Silumgar is the dragon whose brood the Sultai revere; Tasigur offers him tribute.
relations.quote: the progenitor of the entire Silumgar brood
